title: Vectorised Arithmetic and ufuncs
learning_objectives: Replace element-by-element loops with array expressions
Use universal functions (np.exp, np.sqrt, np.abs, np.where)
Check a vectorised result against a loop with np.allclose
Write a sigmoid that never overflows on arrays
entry_point: dot_loop(a, b); dot_vectorized(a, b); fahrenheit(celsius); rms(x); sigmoid(x)
hints: `a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)`; compare `a.shape != b.shape` before multiplying; `float((a * b).sum())`.
`e = np.exp(-np.abs(x)); return np.where(x >= 0, 1 / (1 + e), e / (1 + e))`.

failure_feedback.advice: Multiply the arrays element-wise and call `.sum()`; return a Python float.
Compare the shapes and raise ValueError before multiplying.
Square, average, then take the square root.
Avoid `np.exp(-x)` for very negative x; use `np.exp(-np.abs(x))` with `np.where`.
Keep the input shape: operate on the whole array without flattening.
